{{Quote|An evil looking place. Skulls of past victories litter this site, casting a haunting aura and providing a perfect place for the Korga to mingle. On Endor, I find myself crawling to the top of rocky hills just to see what might be beyond the ridge. Imagine my surprise when, on reaching the top of a particularly treacherous hill of loose rock, I am immediately attacked by Korga.|Excerpt from [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]]'s log|<ref name="SWG:AEL7">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=item|An Explorer's Log (7/8)}}</ref>}}
A '''Solitary Hutt''' was located in the [[Desert of Salma/Legends|Desert of Salma]] on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest moon of Endor]]. It was inhabited by the [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] of the [[Korga]] tribe during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG" /> By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Scout/Legends|explorer]] [[Tinrilo x'Rilsam]] discovered the hutt while exploring Endor. However, the explorer was immediately attacked by the Duloks and was forced to run for his life.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Solitary Hutt was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Solitary Hutt was one of many unmarked points of interests on the moon Endor.<ref name="SWG" /> Following the release of the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]'' expansion pack in [[2004]], rare [[W:c:swg:Data Storage Unit|data storage unit]] devices could sometimes be [[W:c:swg:Loot|looted]] during space battles. One such data storage item, named "an Explorer's Log (7/8)," contained a detailed backstory for the Solitary Hutt.<ref name="SWG:AEL7" />
